descriptionChirho: Proper masculine name Adaiah (עֲדָיָה), borne by several individuals in the Hebrew Bible including a Levite ancestor of Asaph, a priest in post-exilic Jerusalem, and others. Multilingual transliterations are uniform: eng 'Adayah / and-Adayah', spa 'Adaya / y-Adayah', arb 'عَدَايَا / و-عَدَايَا', kor '아다야 / 그리고-아다야', swa 'Adaya / na-Adaya'. The two clusters differ only by the presence or absence of the conjunction waw, representing grammatical variation not semantic distinction.
